g.text: The audio bus: one codec, two possible sources
The WM8758 is the I²S clock master; its clocks reach the PP5022 and the BCM2722 (device sessions 32–34)
[silicon]: with the PP's audio stopped GPIO 1–3 show 0 edges/s; while it plays GPIO 2 and 3 toggle (S32–S34).
GPIO 1 never toggles and follows the BCM's pulls with the PP playing, its TX stopped, and audio off: undriven (S34, stage 8a-0b).
parks GPIO 1 as a driven output.
The BCM's codec-control routine is empty: it never writes the WM8758, so volume stays with the PP.
[hypothesis]: how GPIO 1 reaches DACDAT, and whether a selector must be set (open-questions.md #35, #39).
Nothing has been driven yet; stage 8a-1 (a test tone) waits for the owner's go.
Device logs session32–34 bcmtest.log: stage 8a-0 (GPIO sampled at 630–635 k samples/s), stage 8a-0b (pull test)
